subject: hey
body:
hey {name} — how's it going over there? feels like forever.

— sarah

subject: hello
body:
hi {name}. no real reason for this email, you crossed my mind. hope things are good.

— sarah

subject: still alive
body:
hey {name}, still here. still doing the thing. how about you?

— sarah

subject: tuesday
body:
{name} — I keep thinking it's wednesday and it's not. anyway. how's the week going?

— sarah

subject: hi
body:
hey {name}. that's it. that's the whole email. hi.

— sarah

subject: update
body:
hey {name} — I owe you an update on like five things. short version: all good. long version later.

— sarah

subject: this forbes beach list
body:
hey {name} — fell into this and lost 20 minutes:
https://www.forbes.com/sites/laurabegleybloom/2025/04/29/the-worlds-50-best-beaches-for-2025-according-to-a-new-report/

some of these I'd never heard of.

— sarah

subject: coral reef thing
body:
{name} — read this piece about coral restoration and it stuck with me:
https://coral.org/en/blog/turning-the-tide-for-coral-reefs-in-2025/

kind of hopeful actually.

— sarah

subject: food in mexico city
body:
ok {name} this eater list is dangerous:
https://www.eater.com/maps/best-mexico-city-restaurants-38

now I need to go back.

— sarah

subject: bon appetit cdmx
body:
hey {name}, have you seen the bon appetit mexico city guide?
https://www.bonappetit.com/story/where-to-eat-in-mexico-city

the hacienda de los morales rec is legit.

— sarah

subject: these sunset photos
body:
{name} — CN traveller did a piece on sunsets around the world. some of these photos are unreal.
https://www.cntraveller.com/article/best-sunsets-in-the-world

— sarah

subject: podcast recs
body:
hey {name}, the new yorker did their best podcasts of the year list:
https://www.newyorker.com/culture/2025-in-review/the-best-podcasts-of-2025

added three to my queue already.

— sarah

subject: ocean is wild
body:
standing outside right now {name}, you wouldn't believe the swell. third storm system this month.

— sarah

subject: sky
body:
the sky this morning was absurd. like someone spilled paint across the whole horizon. wish you saw it.

— sarah

subject: pelicans
body:
hey {name} — a line of pelicans just flew past the window, maybe thirty of them. they do this every morning and I still stop and watch every time.

— sarah

subject: golden hour
body:
{name}. the light right now. I can't even describe it. everything is orange.

— sarah

subject: storm rolling in
body:
massive clouds building to the south. looks like it's going to be a real one tonight. kind of excited about it honestly.

— sarah

subject: morning
body:
woke up before the alarm for once and caught the sunrise. worth it. coffee tastes better when the sky looks like that.

— sarah

subject: book
body:
that thing you said about the de waal book — you were right. couldn't put it down. what else have you read lately?

— sarah

subject: coffee
body:
hey {name}, switched to a new coffee and I think I ruined my old one forever. do you have a go-to brand or just whatever's there?

— sarah

subject: morning or evening
body:
morning walks or evening walks. I go back and forth. where do you land on this?

— sarah

subject: restaurant
body:
{name} — tried anywhere good lately? I'm in a rut and keep going to the same three places.

— sarah

subject: re: that question
body:
ok I thought about it. morning walks. obviously morning walks. sorry took me three days to answer this.

— sarah

subject: streaming
body:
hey {name}, have you watched anything good? I've scrolled through every app twice and picked nothing.

— sarah

subject: thanks
body:
hey {name} — tried that place you mentioned. you were right.

— sarah

subject: that rec
body:
{name}, that coffee shop you mentioned — the one with the weird hours? went twice this week. you were not exaggerating.

— sarah

subject: you called it
body:
remember when you said I should go with the second option? yeah. you called it. thanks for that.

— sarah

subject: the book
body:
finished that book you told me about. the ending. I mean. thank you for putting that on my radar.

— sarah

subject: late reply
body:
hey {name}, I know this is late but that thing you said about not overthinking the small stuff — it actually changed how I handle mornings now.

— sarah

subject: the spot
body:
went back to that spot you told me about. even better the second time. ordering the same thing every time now.

— sarah
